# Precision Roofing Alabama LLC

> Licensed and insured residential roofing contractor serving the State of Alabama. Roof replacement, roof repair, storm and hail damage restoration, and full insurance claim help. Free inspections, written estimates, and financing available.

Precision Roofing Alabama LLC is a family-run roofing company based in Opelika, Alabama, serving homeowners statewide, with crews working regularly in Montgomery, Birmingham, Huntsville, Auburn, Opelika, and Baldwin County. The company is a CertainTeed certified contractor and holds Alabama Home Builder license HB # 41012. Company motto: "Built with Precision. Protected for Years."

- Legal name: Precision Roofing Alabama LLC

- Hours: Monday through Saturday, 8 AM to 6 PM. Sunday by appointment.
- Service area: State of Alabama, concentrated in Montgomery, Birmingham, Huntsville, Auburn, Opelika, and Baldwin County
- Customer rating: 5.0 stars on Google
- Free roof inspections and written estimates, with no obligation
- Financing available for a range of budgets and credit situations

## Services

- [Roof Replacement](https://www.precisionroofingalabama.com/roof-replacements): Full tear-off and rebuild to manufacturer spec using CertainTeed products. Most homes are completed in a single day.
- [Roof Repair](https://www.precisionroofingalabama.com/roof-repairs): Leaks, missing shingles, flashing failures, and decking damage. Repairs are recommended over replacement whenever a repair will genuinely solve the problem.
- [Storm and Hail Damage](https://www.precisionroofingalabama.com/storm-damage): Free post-storm inspection, photo documentation of wind and hail damage, and full roof restoration.
- [Metal Roofing](https://www.precisionroofingalabama.com/metal-roofing): Installs both metal and architectural shingle systems, with honest side-by-side comparisons of cost, lifespan, heat performance, and resale for Alabama homes.
- [Repair or Replace Guide](https://www.precisionroofingalabama.com/repair-or-replace): How Precision Roofing Alabama decides between repair and replacement, with a standing promise that the cheaper fix wins when it will do the job. Free second opinions after storm-chaser verdicts and denied claims.
- [Insurance Claim Help](https://www.precisionroofingalabama.com/insurance-claims): Damage documentation, meeting the adjuster on site, and step-by-step claim guidance while the homeowner stays in control of the claim. In Alabama a roofing contractor cannot legally negotiate an insurance claim for a homeowner, and Precision Roofing Alabama works within that law.

## Common questions

- How long does a roof replacement take? Most homes are completed in a single day. Larger or more complex roofs may take two.
- Do you help with insurance claims? Yes. Precision Roofing Alabama inspects the roof, documents damage with photos, and works directly with the adjuster.
- What roofing materials do you use? CertainTeed products, including premium architectural shingles chosen to hold up to Alabama heat, humidity, and severe storms.
- Do you offer free estimates? Yes. Every roof inspection and estimate is free and carries no obligation.
- Do you offer financing? Yes, for a range of budgets and credit situations, including covering an insurance deductible.
- Do you install metal roofs? Yes. Precision Roofing Alabama installs both metal and architectural shingle roofs and prices both options on the actual roof so homeowners can compare honestly.
- Can a roofer negotiate my insurance claim in Alabama? No. Alabama law does not allow a roofing contractor to negotiate a claim for a homeowner. Precision Roofing Alabama documents damage, meets the adjuster on the roof, and explains the estimate while the homeowner stays in control.
- Is a repair or a replacement the right call? Precision Roofing Alabama recommends a repair whenever a repair will actually solve the problem, and only raises replacement when a repair no longer makes financial sense.
